title: Planner routing output (fabro-9ec3 arm 3)
description: Replaces output_schema="routing" on the planner node: keeps the routing contract (required routing fields, preferred_next_label restricted to the node's outgoing edge labels) and adds the brief gate-command ban — the fabro-017f teeth pattern. A current_seed_brief containing the PROJECT_FACTS gate command (`just qualitygate`) or its byte-equivalent full-gate body (`nu scripts/qualitygate.nu`) fails validation, burns an output retry, and never passes silently. context_updates stays otherwise open (journal, seed keys, ...) exactly like the routing kind did.

current_seed_brief.description: Gate-command ban: the implementer never runs the full gate in any form; verification criteria must say 'gate green via the deterministic tester step'.
